title: Internal links to broken (4xx/5xx) pages
why_it_matters: A prospect clicking a dead 'Admissions' or program link leaves; link equity is lost.
fix: Redirect or fix the targets, then update the source links.
check_first: GSC > Pages > Not found (404): which have impressions? Call tracking: calls from these landing URLs before they broke.

title: Sitemap lists URLs that do not return 200
why_it_matters: Google trusts the sitemap less and wastes crawl budget on dead URLs.
fix: Regenerate the sitemap from live, indexable URLs only.
check_first: GSC > Pages > 'Not found (404)' and 'Redirect error' filtered to sitemap URLs.

title: AI answer presence not verified (no API key / no manual results)
pages: best alcohol rehab in River Rd Pike Nashville, TN
drug rehab in River Rd Pike Nashville, TN that takes insurance
residential addiction treatment near River Rd Pike Nashville, TN
inpatient mental health and addiction treatment River Rd Pike Nashville, TN
is Cumberland Heights a good rehab, what insurance does it take
evidence: Queries written to ai_queries.txt. Set PERPLEXITY_API_KEY or pass --ai-results <json> after checking manually.
why_it_matters: Cannot rank what we did not measure; this stays a hypothesis until checked.
fix: Run the queries, record results, re-run the audit with --ai-results.

title: Thin program/location/admissions pages (under 300 words)
why_it_matters: Pages that cannot answer 'what happens, who is it for, what does it cost, is it covered' rarely rank for city + program queries and are rarely quoted by AI engines.
fix: Expand each to cover program description, levels of care, insurance, admission steps, staff, FAQ.
check_first: GSC: impressions vs clicks per page; which program queries do these pages appear for at position 8-20?

title: Program and blog pages lack medical reviewer / author bylines
evidence: 0 of 16 program/content pages show 'medically reviewed' or a credentialed byline
why_it_matters: Health content without visible expertise ranks worse after Google's helpful-content/E-E-A-T updates and is less likely to be cited by AI engines.
fix: Add 'Medically reviewed by <Name, credentials>' with a linked bio to every program and blog page.
check_first: GSC: did blog/program clicks drop around core updates? Which pages lost positions 1-5?

title: Program pages have no FAQ / direct-answer sections
evidence: 1 of 16 program pages have 3+ question headings or FAQPage schema
why_it_matters: AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity lift 40-80 word passages that answer a question directly (cost, length of stay, insurance, detox). Without them the site is paraphrased from directories instead of cited.
fix: Add a 4-6 question FAQ to every program/location page (what it costs, insurance, how long, what to bring, visiting, detox) with FAQPage JSON-LD.
check_first: GSC: question-style queries ('how long', 'does', 'what is') where the site ranks 5-15.

title: Redirect chains and internal links to redirecting URLs
evidence: 22 internal links point at redirecting URLs (e.g. https://www.cumberlandheights.org/contact-us)
why_it_matters: Each hop adds latency on mobile and leaks ranking signals.
fix: Update internal links to final URLs; collapse chains to a single 301.
check_first: GSC crawl stats: redirect share of crawl requests.

title: Missing or duplicate title tags
why_it_matters: The title is the ad headline in search; duplicates make program pages compete with each other.
check_first: GSC Performance: pages with high impressions and CTR under 2%.

title: Missing meta descriptions
why_it_matters: Google writes its own snippet, usually without the phone number, insurance or '24/7' hook.
fix: Write descriptions that state program, location, insurance accepted and a call prompt.
check_first: GSC: CTR on high-impression program pages.

title: Same address written in different ways across the site
evidence: '8283 River Rd Pike Nashville, TN 37209' (36 pages) | '8283 River Road Pike Nashville, TN 37209' (1 pages)
why_it_matters: NAP inconsistency between site, GBP and citations erodes local pack trust.
fix: Pick one canonical format per facility (match GBP exactly) and use it in footer, location pages and schema.
check_first: Compare against GBP listing and top citations (Psychology Today, SAMHSA locator).

title: Homepage lacks a complete Organization/MedicalOrganization schema
evidence: telephone: no, address: no, sameAs: no
why_it_matters: Entity data (name, phone, address, sameAs to GBP/Wikipedia/socials) is how Google and AI engines confirm who you are. It feeds the knowledge panel and AI answer citations.
fix: Add MedicalOrganization JSON-LD with name, url, logo, telephone, address, areaServed, medicalSpecialty, sameAs[].
check_first: GSC: Enhancements/Rich results reports; search the brand name and see whether a knowledge panel appears.

title: Accreditation mentioned on the site but not on the homepage
why_it_matters: Most first visits land on the homepage; the seal belongs there and in the footer.
fix: Add the seal and a one-line statement to the footer template.

title: 3 different phone numbers in tel: links
why_it_matters: Multiple numbers can be legitimate call-tracking swaps, but if they are hard-coded they fragment NAP consistency and Google Business Profile matching.
fix: One primary admissions number in schema and footer; use dynamic number insertion (CallRail/CTM) for tracking rather than hard-coded variants.
check_first: Call tracking: are these pool numbers? If any number is not in the tracking tool, find who owns it.

title: Title tags too long or too short
evidence: 84 chars: Introduction to AA Meetings: What to Expect on Your First Visit - Cumberland Hei
70 chars: What to Expect During Detox: A Step-by-Step Guide - Cumberland Heights
94 chars: The Many Benefits You Can Find Through Sober Living Homes: What to Expect - Cumb
why_it_matters: Truncated titles hide the location or program name in results.
fix: Keep the program + city in the first 55 characters.
check_first: GSC CTR by page vs. position.

title: Missing or multiple H1 headings
evidence: 1 pages with no H1, 0 with more than one
why_it_matters: Weak topical signal for program/location pages.
fix: One H1 per page naming the service and place.

title: No LegitScript certification mentioned
why_it_matters: LegitScript certification is required to run Google/Meta ads for addiction treatment and is a visible trust badge; its absence may also mean paid search is unavailable.
fix: Get certified (if not) and show the badge in the footer.
check_first: Check legitscript.com certified list for the facility.

title: No staff page with clinical credentials found
evidence: 0 staff/team pages crawled; none list MD/LCSW/LADAC-style credentials in text
why_it_matters: Named clinicians with credentials are what families, Google raters and AI engines use to judge legitimacy.
fix: Clinical team page with photo, name, credentials, role; Person schema.
